typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		SUBSC_HCID as string,
		SUB_GRGR_ID as string,
		DEP_HCID as string,
		DEP_GRGR_ID as string,
		GRPBILLENTITY as string,
		{MIN(SUB_EFF)} as timestamp,
		{MAX(SUB_TERM)} as timestamp,
		{MIN(DEP_EFF)} as timestamp,
		{MAX(DEP_TERM)} as timestamp,
		INVOICENBR as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'WITH CTE AS ( SELECT INIV.*,SUB.SUBSC_HCID,SUB.SUB_GRGR_ID,DEP.DEP_HCID,DEP.DEP_GRGR_ID FROM AGP.BILLING_INV_FAML INIV  INNER JOIN AGP.BILLING_MDSUPP_FAMILY SUB      ON SUB.FAMILYLINK_BGBG_ID = INIV.GRPBillEntity INNER JOIN AGP.BILLING_MDSUPP_FAMILY DEP      ON DEP.FAMILYLINK_BGBG_ID = INIV.GRPBillEntity ),CTE2 AS( SELECT DISTINCT C.*,MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AS SUB_EFF,MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT AS SUB_TERM,MEP.MEPE_EFF_DT AS DEP_EFF,MEP.MEPE_TERM_DT AS DEP_TERM FROM CTE C LEFT OUTER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON SBSB.SBSB_ID = C.SUBSC_HCID  LEFT JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK =SBSB.SBSB_CK LEFT JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEPE.MEME_CK =MEME.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND =\'Y\' LEFT JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBS ON SBS.SBSB_ID = C.DEP_HCID  LEFT JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEM ON MEM.SBSB_CK =SBS.SBSB_CK LEFT JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEP ON MEP.MEME_CK =MEM.MEME_CK AND  MEP.MEPE_ELIG_IND =\'Y\' ) SELECT INVOICENBR,GRPBILLENTITY,SUBSC_HCID,SUB_GRGR_ID,DEP_HCID,DEP_GRGR_ID,MIN(SUB_EFF),MAX(SUB_TERM),MIN(DEP_EFF),MAX(DEP_TERM) FROM CTE2 GROUP BY INVOICENBR,GRPBILLENTITY,SUBSC_HCID,SUB_GRGR_ID,DEP_HCID,DEP_GRGR_ID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBFAMLINACTIVE
SRCOLEDBFAMLINACTIVE derive({Copy of DEP_GRGR_ID} = toString(DEP_GRGR_ID),
		{Copy of GRPBILLENTITY} = toString(GRPBILLENTITY),
		{Copy of SUB_GRGR_ID} = toString(SUB_GRGR_ID),
		{Copy of DEP_HCID} = toString(DEP_HCID),
		{Copy of INVOICENBR} = toString(INVOICENBR),
		{Copy of SUBSC_HCID} = toString(SUBSC_HCID)) ~> DFTDCNVFAML
